title: Reducing Capital Market Anomaly: The Role of Information Technology Using an Information Uncertainty Lens
authors: Ning Jia; Arun Rai; Sean Xin Xu
eligible_reason: The DiD is a portfolio-sort comparison of PSM-matched ES implementers and control firms in event time (pre-ES years -8..-1 vs post-ES 1..8): Tables 5-7 report differences in mean IU-induced underreaction anomaly (4x4 momentum/IU portfolio returns) with Newey-West t-stats; no regression with firm and calendar-time FE, matching-based. Only the ES announcement years are shipped.
design_notes: 572 ES implementations with go-live years 1997-2014 (es_adopt.dta: 748 cusip6-year0 rows). Each ES firm is matched 1:1 on a propensity score to a control firm; anomaly computed from return portfolios in pre/post windows. No firm-year panel regression in the main text.
data_files_note: Read-me: file contains only the cusip and event year (year 0) of the initial sample of ES announcements. CRSP/Compustat/IBES outcome data and code are not shipped.
